shellCommands.command: cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md && ls -la && ls -R .agents | head -100 && cat AGENTS.md

head -60 .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; echo ----; grep -n -i -E "chart|graph|yagr|plot" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | head -50; echo ----; cat package.json tsconfig.json vite.config.ts index.html .gitignore; find src -type f | xargs wc -l; ls __agent_eval__; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui

sed -n 492,520p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; echo ----; cat src/*.tsx src/vite-env.d.ts; echo ----; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | grep '"version"'; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>&1 | head
cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md
npm view @gravity-ui/yagr version peerDependencies dependencies 2>&1 | tail -20

npm install @gravity-ui/yagr 2>&1 | tail -5 && grep version node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/package.json && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist; .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh yagr Yagr YagrConfig

bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh yagr Yagr YagrConfig 2>&1 | head -40; echo ----; wc -l node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/README.md; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/README.md | head -150; echo ----; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/react.d.ts; grep -n '"exports"' -A30 node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/package.json
cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist && ls YagrCore YagrCore/*/ 2>/dev/null | head -60; cat index.d.ts; wc -l YagrCore/types.d.ts YagrCore/index.d.ts
cat YagrCore/index.d.ts YagrCore/mixins/dynamic-updates.d.ts YagrCore/mixins/batch-updates.d.ts
cat YagrCore/types.d.ts
sed -n 1,200p react.mjs | grep -v sourceMappingURL | head -120; echo ----; cat YagrCore/utils/colors.js | head -80

grep -n "src/react.tsx" react.mjs; awk '/^\/\/ src\/react.tsx/{c++} c==2{print}' react.mjs | head -120; echo ----; sed -n 1,400p YagrCore/mixins/dynamic-updates.js | grep -n -E "setTheme|function setSeriesImpl|incremental|splice|setThemeImpl|colors|reinit|redraw" | head -50
sed -n 1,30p YagrCore/mixins/dynamic-updates.js; sed -n 196,352p YagrCore/mixins/dynamic-updates.js

grep -n -E "colors\.(parse|toRgba)|setContext" -r YagrCore --include=*.js | head -20; echo ----; sed -n 1,200p YagrCore/defaults.js | grep -n -E "class ThemedDefaults|setTheme|GRID|AXIS_STROKE|BACKGROUND|get |SHIFT|color" | head -40; echo ---; grep -n -E "precision|formatter|value:|values" YagrCore/plugins/tooltip/types.d.ts | head -30; ls YagrCore/plugins/tooltip
grep -o -E "\.yagr[^{]*\{[^}]*\}" index.css | head -20; echo; sed -n 45,70p YagrCore/utils/series.js; echo ----; sed -n 100,175p YagrCore/plugins/tooltip/types.d.ts

head -c 2500 index.css; echo; grep -c "" index.css; grep -n -E "yagr_theme|--yagr-" index.css | head -30; sed -n 70,100p YagrCore/plugins/tooltip/types.d.ts; grep -n "PerScale" YagrCore/plugins/tooltip/types.d.ts | head -3

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit && ls build/esm/components/theme/; cat build/esm/components/theme/index.d.ts; grep -n -E "Effect|body|classList|updateBodyClassName" build/esm/components/theme/ThemeProvider.js | head; cat build/esm/components/theme/useThemeValue.d.ts build/esm/components/theme/useTheme.d.ts 2>/dev/null; cd ../yagr/dist && grep -n "AXIS_STROKE\|theme\." YagrCore/utils/axes.js | head; sed -n 1,80p YagrCore/mixins/batch-updates.js | grep -v "^ *\*" | head -60

cd /home/sandbox/workspace && grep -n -o -E "\-\-g-color-(line|text|base|sfx)-[a-z-]+" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/theming.md | sort -u -t: -k2 | awk -F: '{print $2}' | sort -u | tr '\n' ' '; echo; sed -n 1,30p node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/types.d.ts; sed -n 185,300p node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/index.css | grep -n -E "^\.|--yagr|color|background|box-shadow" | head -40

grep -n -E "base-float|text-secondary|text-complementary|text-hint|sfx-shadow|base-background|line-generic|base-info|line-info|text-info|utility|chart|elevation|--g-font-family|--g-text-body" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/theming.md | head -40; grep -o -E "\-\-g-color-(base-(info|float|background|misc)[a-z-]*|line-(info|generic)[a-z-]*|text-(secondary|complementary|hint|info|misc)[a-z-]*|sfx-shadow[a-z-]*)" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css | sort -u | tr '\n' ' '; echo; grep -o -E "\-\-g-(font-family|text-caption-[12]-font-size|text-body-1-font-size|text-body-short-font-size)[a-z-]*" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css | sort -u | tr '\n' ' '
bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Card Text Flex Button Loader Alert Label 2>&1 | head -40

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components && sed -n 1,80p Card/Card.d.ts | grep -v "^\s*//" ; grep -n -E "export|variant|color|ellipsis" Text/Text.d.ts | head; grep -n -E "TEXT_COLORS|TEXT_VARIANTS" -A3 text/text.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; ls text 2>/dev/null; grep -n -E "view\??:|title|message|theme\??:|actions|layout" Alert/types.d.ts | head -20; grep -n -E "size|view|onClick|selected" Button/Button.d.ts | head; grep -n "size" Loader/Loader.d.ts; grep -n -E "theme\??:|size\??:" Label/Label.d.ts

cat Text/colorText/colorText.d.ts | grep -n -E "colorText|'" | head -20; grep -n -E "AlertTheme =|AlertView =|AlertAction " -A2 Alert/types.d.ts | head -15; grep -rn "ButtonSize =\|ButtonView =" Button/*.d.ts | head; grep -n "LoaderSize" Loader/Loader.d.ts; grep -rn "TEXT_VARIANTS\|'caption-2'" Text/text/text.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -3; ls Text
sed -n 1,12p Text/colorText/colorText.d.ts; grep -n -E "gap\??:|direction|alignItems|justifyContent|wrap\??:" layout/Flex/Flex.d.ts | head

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist && grep -n -E "onUpdate|reset\b|reset =|reset\(\)|const reset" YagrCore/plugins/tooltip/tooltip.js | head -20; grep -n "isMouseOver" -r YagrCore --include=*.js | head
grep -n "className" YagrCore/plugins/tooltip/tooltip.js | head -5; grep -n "dispose()" -A22 YagrCore/index.js | head -30

cd /home/sandbox/workspace && grep -n -E "spacing\??:" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/layout/Box/Box.d.ts; grep -o -E "\-\-g-spacing-[0-9]+" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css | sort -u | tr '\n' ' '; echo; sed -n 1,60p node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/YagrCore/plugins/legend/legend.d.ts | grep -n -E "show|interface LegendOptions"; grep -n "values?:" -A6 node_modules/uplot/dist/uPlot.d.ts | head -20; grep -n "useThemeType\b" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/useThemeType.d.ts
npx tsc --noEmit -p . 2>&1 | head -30
npm run build 2>&1 | tail -15
npx vitest run --root /tmp/cpucheck 2>&1 | grep -E "points|Expected|Received" | head

for f in src/monitoring/*.ts src/monitoring/*.tsx src/monitoring/*.css src/App.tsx; do perl -i -pe 's/^((?:    )+)/"  " x (length($1)\/4)/e' "$f"; done && npx vitest run --root /tmp/cpucheck 2>&1 | grep -E "points|Tests" && npm run build 2>&1 | grep -E "error|built" ; rm -rf dist /tmp/cpucheck; git status --short
